line: What good will that do? You saw what happened to Ed Appel when he shot at it. How about those other people before the monster got them?

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: I'm sorry, Schmitter. I know how you feel, but we've got to have guards.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Okay, Chief. I'll do what I can.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Keep alert. If you hear anything or see anything, call in. Somebody can arrive in three minutes.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: A lot can happen in three minutes. Chief, is it true the Enterprise is on its way?

title: The Devil In The Dark

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: You think it could get here in the next four hours?

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: You'll be all right.

title: The Devil In The Dark

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Schmitter. Like the rest of them. Burned to a crisp.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Captain's log, stardate 3196.1. A distress call from the pergium production station on Janus Six has brought the Enterprise to that long-established colony. Mister Spock, Doctor McCoy, and I have beamed down to meet with Chief Engineer Vanderberg, administrative head of Janus Six.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: All right, let's assume there is a monster. What has it done? When did it start?

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: About three months ago, we opened up a new level. Sensors gave us an unusually rich pergium reading. Not only pergium, whatever you want. Uranium, sirium, platinum. The whole planet's like that. It's a treasure house.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Yes, we're aware of that. If mining conditions weren't so difficult, Janus Six could supply the mineral needs of a thousand planets. But what happened?

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: First, the automatic machinery, piece by piece, started to almost disintegrate. Metal began dissolving away. There was no reason for it, and our chemists were unable to analyze the corrosive agent.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: I'm sure there is an answer. It simply has not yet been discovered.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Yes, it has. I don't know what this butchering monster is, but I know what it's doing. Our maintenance engineers sent down to the drifts to repair the corroded machinery. We found them seared to a crisp.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Volcanic activity?

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: There is no current volcanic activity on this planet, Captain.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: He's right. None. At first the deaths were down deep, but they've been moving up toward our levels. The last man died two days ago three levels below this.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Same way? Burned?

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: I'd like to examine the body.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: We kept it for you. There isn't much left. Roberts will show you. It isn't pretty.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Do you post sentries? Guards?

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Of course. Five of them have died.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Who else has seen this?

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: I have.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: This is Ed Appel, chief processing engineer.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Describe it.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: I can't. I only got a glimpse of it, but it's big and shaggy.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Ed shot it.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Oh. You mean shot at it.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: No. I mean shot it. With this.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Fascinating.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: A good, clean shot. Didn't even slow it down. Well, I've made my report to you. Production has stopped, nobody will go into the lower levels, and I don't blame them. If the Federation wants pergium, then you're going to have to do something about it.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: That's why we're here, Mister Vanderberg.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: You're all pretty tough, aren't you? Starship, phaser banks. You can't get your starship down in the tunnels.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: I don't think we'll need to, Mister Appel. Mister Vanderberg, we'll need a complete subsurface chart of all the drifts, galleries and tunnels. Mister Vanderberg, I'll need a complete subsurface chart of all the drifts, galleries, tunnels.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: You'll get it.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Mister Vanderberg, what is this?

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: It's a silicon nodule. There are a millions of them are down there. No commercial value.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: But a geological oddity, to say the least. Pure silicon?

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: A few trace elements. Look, we didn't call you here so you could collect rocks.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Thank you, Mister Vanderberg. We'll need your complete co-operation.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: You'll have it. Just find that creature, whatever it is. I've got a quota to meet. Come on, Appel.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: The vast number of tunnels won't make our hunting any easier. Doc?

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Schmitter didn't burn to death, not in the usual sense, anyway.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Explain.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Well, there are only fragments of bone and teeth left, but the plant's physician agrees with me. A chemical corrosion. Almost as if he'd been thrown into a vat of extremely corrosive acid.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Strong enough to eat machinery?

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Strong enough to eat anything else that you can think of.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Mister Spock.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: I've charted the positions of the deaths and acts of sabotage. Here, here, and here. If the times of these incidents are to be accepted as accurate, the creature would have to have moved at an incredible rate of speed.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Mister Vanderberg, how recent are these charts?

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: They were made last year.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Before the appearance of whatever it is?

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: That's right.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: I see. Mister Spock give us a report on life beneath the surface. Within range of our sensors, there is no life, other than the accountable human residents of this colony beneath the surface. At least, no life as we know it.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: We can't cover tunnel by tunnel on foot. We must get production going again. We must have that pergium.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: If we could force another appearance of this creature

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: When that creature appears, men die.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Too many tunnels. We couldn't possibly. Mister Spock, our sensors can pick up normal life functions at a considerable distance, but what about abnormal life functions?

line: Something's happening in the reactor room!

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Back to your stations. Look at that.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: I wouldn't touch it, Captain. An extremely active corrosive. Traces may linger.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Kirk, quickly!

line: The main circulating pump for the entire reactor is gone.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: The same indication as shown at the door, Captain. A very strong corrosive.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Is there a replacement for that?

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: No, none. It's outdated, but we never had any trouble with it.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Spock, on board?

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Nothing for a device this antiquated, Captain.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Without the pump mechanism, the reactor will go supercritical. It could poison half the planet. We can't shut it down. It provides heat and air and life support for the whole colony.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Mister Spock, we seem to have been given a choice. Death by asphyxiation or death by radiation poisoning.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: A PXK pergium reactor? No, sir. We don't have any spare circulating pump for a thing like that. I haven't seen a PXK in twenty years.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Can you rig one up? It's vital.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Well sir, I can put together some odds and ends, but it won't hold for long.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: How long?

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Forty eight hours maybe, with a bit of luck.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Forty eight hours is better than nothing. Gather what you need and beam down here with it.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Top priority.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Aye, Captain.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: I'll be right down. Scott out.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: What happens when it breaks down?

line: Hopefully we'll have found the missing part by then.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Hopefully. Small chance.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: We'll have to, Chief. The alternative is to evacuate all you people up to the Enterprise. A dozen planets depend on you for pergium for their reactor. They're already screaming. Reactors closing down, life support systems

line: I'm concerned with my people right here, Kirk. They're being murdered. You find that monster and kill it.

line: The missing pump wasn't taken by accident. It was the one piece of equipment absolutely essential for the operation of the reactor.

line: Do you think the creature is trying to push the colonists off the planet?

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: It would seem so.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: But why now, Mister Spock? These production facilities have been in operation for over fifty years.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: I don't know. But there is a possibility.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: What's that?

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Life as we know it is universally based on some combination of carbon compounds, but what if life exists based on another element? For instance, silicon.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: You're creating fantasies, Mister Spock.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Not necessarily, Bones. I've heard of the theoretical possibility of life based on silicon. A silicon-based life would be of an entirely different order. It's possible that our phasers might not affect it.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Certainly not phaser one, which is far less powerful than phaser two.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: All right, how about this? A creature that lives deep in the planet below us, at home in solid rock. It seems to me that in order to survive, it would have to have some form of natural armor plating.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: It could explain much, especially since the colonists are armed only with phaser one.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: But our people have phaser number two.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Which I could adjust to be more effective against silicon.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Silicon-based life is physiologically impossible, especially in an oxygen atmosphere.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: It may be, Doctor, that the creature can exist for brief periods in such an atmosphere before returning to its own environment.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: I still think you're imagining things.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: You may be right, Doctor, but at least it's something to go on. Mister Spock, have Lieutenant Commander Giotto assemble the security troops and arm them with phaser number two. You make the proper adjustments. You seem fascinated by this rock.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Yes, Captain. You recall that Vanderberg commented there were thousands of these at a lower level, the level which the machinery opened just prior to the first appearance of the creature.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Do they tie in?

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: I don't know.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Speculate.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: I have already given Doctor McCoy sufficient cause for amusement. I'd prefer to cogitate the possibilities for a time.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: A short time, Mister Spock. We have very little.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: How's it going, Scotty?

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Well sir, it's a plumber's nightmare, but it'll hold for a bit.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: It has to hold longer than a bit.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Sorry, sir. That's about the best I can do, but I guarantee it's not good enough.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Kirk here.

line: Captain, the security officers have gathered in Chief Vanderberg's office.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: I'll be right there. Kirk out. Scotty, ride herd on it. Kind words. Tender, loving care. Kiss it. Baby it. Flatter it if you have to, but keep it going.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: I'll do what I can, sir.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: You will proceed from level to level, checking out every foot, every opening. You are searching for some sort of creature which is highly resistant to phaser fire. Phasers will be set on maximum, and remember this. Fifty people have died. I want no more deaths.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Except the bloody thing.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: The creature may or may not attack on sight. However, you must. It is vitally important we get this installation back into production.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Mister Vanderberg, may I ask at which level you discovered the nodules of silicon?

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: The twenty-third. Why? Commander Giotto, take your detail. Go directly to the twenty-third level. Start your search there.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Aye, aye, sir. May I ask if you have reason to suspect this creature may be on that level?

line: It's one of the possibilities we've discussed. I want your people to stay on the top level, together at a safe place.

line: Well, gentlemen, you have your instructions. Let's get at it.

title: The Devil In The Dark

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Adjusting my tricorder to register for silicon, Captain. Interesting.

title: The Devil In The Dark

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: A life form, Captain. Bearing one hundred eleven degrees, elevation four degrees.

line: One of our people?

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: No, sir. Silicon.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Come on.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: He never even had a chance to fire, Captain.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: It's only been seconds since we heard him scream. The creature must still be around.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Captain.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: This tunnel. My readings indicate it was made within the hour. Moments ago, in fact.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Are you certain?

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Positive.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: This tunnel goes back as far as the eye can see. Our best machinery couldn't cut a tunnel like this, not even with phasers.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Indeed, Captain. I'm quite at a loss.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Gone.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Disappeared. Astonishing that anything of that bulk could move so rapidly.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: These walls are hot.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Indeed. This tunnel was cut within the last two minutes.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Yes, perfectly.

line: Did you see it?

line: Yes, we saw it. Where does the tunnel go?

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Readings indicate a maze of tunnels of this general category in that direction.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Did you shoot at it?

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Yes. We took a bite out of it.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: It's not animal tissue. What is it?

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: The closest approximation I could come to would be fibrous asbestos. A mineral, Captain.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Then your guess was right.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: It would seem so. Silicon-based.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Summation.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: We are dealing with a silicon creature of the deep rocks, capable of moving through solid rock as easily as we move through the air.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: That would account for the tunnels.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Correct. This creature's body secretes an extremely powerful corrosive.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Powerful enough to dissolve the door of the reactor chamber.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: And it explains the murdered men.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: It's definitely phaser resistant. We had our weapons set for silicon and on full power, yet we only damaged it. It still lives.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: No. No, it might require amassed phasers.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Or a single phaser with much longer contact.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Commander, pass this on to your men We knew it was a killer. Now it's wounded, probably in pain somewhere back there. There's nothing more dangerous than a wounded animal. Commander Giotto, instruct your men to concentrate the search in this sector. Remind them the creature is wounded.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Aye, aye, sir.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: What is it, Mister Spock?

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: I've run a complete spherical check on all life forms, radius one hundred miles. I've located our men, all of them, and I've located one creature moving rapidly through native rock, bearing two hundred and one. And that is all.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: One creature in a hundred miles?

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Exactly. Captain, there are literally thousands of these tunnels in this general area alone, far too many to be cut by the one creature in an ordinary lifetime.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Then we're dealing with more than one creature, despite your tricorder readings, or we have a creature with an extremely long life span.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Or it is the last of a race of creatures which made these tunnels. If so, if it is the only survivor of a dead race, to kill it would be a crime against science.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Mister Spock, our mission is to protect this colony, to get the pergium moving again. This is not a zoological expedition. Maintain a constant reading on the creature. If we have to, we'll use phasers to cut our own tunnels. We'll try to surround it. I'm sorry, Mister Spock, but I'm afraid the creature must die.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: I see no alternative myself, Captain. It merely seems a pity. The search team is gathering in the main tunnel.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Good.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: So it is wounded, and therefore twice as dangerous. Stay in pairs. If you see it, concentrate your phaser fire at what appears to be its head. Concentrate it. Maintain it. It is definitely resistant, but it can be hurt. And if it can be hurt, it can be killed. Mister Spock.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Gentlemen, if you'll examine your charts, please. I last located the creature in the area marked adit26 moving in bearing two zero one. This particular group will move out beyond that area in all directions in an effort to surround it, and possibly capture it.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Your orders are shoot to kill. Protect yourself at all times. Commander Giotto, disperse your search parties.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Aye, aye, sir. Louis, Vinci, take your men out.

line: Mister Spock. Capture it? I don't recall giving any such order.

line: I will lose no more men. The creature will be killed on sight and that's the end of it.

line: Very well, sir.

line: Mister Spock. I want you to assist Scotty in maintaining that makeshift circulating pump.

line: You heard me. It's vital that we keep that reactor in operation. Your scientific knowledge

line: Is not needed there, sir. Mister Scott has far more knowledge of nuclear reactors than I do. You're aware of that.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Mister Spock, you are second in command. This will be a dangerous hunt. Either one of us by himself is expendable. Both of us are not.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Captain, there are approximately one hundred of us engaged in this search, against one creature. The odds against you and I both being killed are 2,228.7 to 1.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: 2,228.7 to 1? Those are pretty good odds, Mister Spock.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: And they are of course accurate, Captain.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Of course. Well, I hate to use the word, but logically, with those kind of odds, you might as well stay. But please stay out of trouble, Mister Spock.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: That is always my intention, Captain.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Kirk here.

line: Scotty here, Captain. My brilliant improvisation Just gave up the ghost. It couldn't stand the strain.

title: The Devil In The Dark

line: Negative, Captain. It's gone for good.

line: Start immediate evacuation of all colonists to the Enterprise.

line: We'll be down to join you.

line: Good. Get everybody else aboard the Enterprise. The fewer people we have breathing the air down here, the longer the rest of us will be able to hold out. How much longer, Scotty?

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: We'll do our best. Start feeding us constant status reports, Scotty. Vanderberg, you and your crew assemble at level twenty three, checkpoint Tiger. Kirk out.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Mister Spock?

line: Are you sure? Intuition?

line: The chart says both of these tunnels converge a few thousand yards further. You take the left. I'll take the right.

line: Mister Spock.

line: I've found a whole layer of these silicon nodules of yours, hundreds of them.

line: Explain.

line: Captain? Are you all right? Jim? Jim!

line: Very well, but I find it extremely disquieting that your roof chose that particular moment to collapse. Please proceed with extreme caution. I shall quicken my pace.

In great pain, of course, because of its wound, but not reacting at all like a wounded creature. It calls itself a Horta.

line: A Horta. A Horta! Mister Spock, we need that retardation mechanism. You must re-establish communications with it.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Yes, I'm aware of that. If we could only win its confidence. Doctor McCoy, this is Captain Kirk.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Is somebody injured? What happened?

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Never mind. Just come down to the twenty third level. You'll be led to us by tricorder readings. Kirk out.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Jim, I remind you that this is a silicon-based form of life. Doctor McCoy's medical knowledge will be totally useless.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: He's a healer, let him heal. Mister Spock, you must re-establish communications. I want to know why it suddenly took to murder.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: To obtain that kind of communication, Captain, it will be necessary to touch it.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: We've seen how the creature destroys.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Lieutenant Commander Giotto.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Giotto here, Captain. Are you all right?

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Perfectly all right. Where are you?

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: We're at the end of the tunnel. Mister Vanderberg and his men are here, and they're pretty ugly. Shall I let them through?

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Under no circumstances allow them in here yet. The minute Doc McCoy gets there, send him through.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Aye, aye, sir.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Murder. Of thousands. Devils! Eternity ends. The chamber of the ages. The altar of tomorrow! Murderers! Stop them. Kill! Strike back! Monsters!

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: What in the name of? What is Spock doing?

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: It's wounded. Badly. You've got to help it.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Help that?

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Go take a look.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: The end of life. Murderers.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: You can't be serious. That thing is virtually made out of stone!

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Help it. Treat it.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: I'm a doctor, not a bricklayer.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: You're a healer. There's a patient. That's an order. Mister Spock. Tell it we're trying to help. The mechanism.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Understood. It is the end of life. Eternity stops. Go out into the tunnel. To the chamber of the ages. Cry for the children. Walk carefully in the vault of tomorrow. Sorrow for the murdered children. The thing you search for is there. Go. Go. Sadness. Sadness for the end of things. Go into the tunnel. There is a passageway. Quickly, quickly.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: The Captain said for you to wait here, and here is where you'll wait.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: That murdering monster's in there and we're going to kill it.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: You're going to stay here.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: That's right, Lieutenant. Just beam it down to me immediately, and never mind what I want it for. I just want it! Now move!

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: It is time to sleep. It is over. Failure. The murderers have won. Death is welcome. Let it end here.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Mister Spock. Mister Spock. Spock. Spock! Come out of it. I found the unit in there. It's in pretty good shape. I also found about a million of these silicon nodules. They're eggs, aren't they?

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Yes, Captain, eggs and about to hatch.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: The miners must have broken into the hatchery. Their operations destroyed thousands of them. No wonder.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: There. They're coming.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: All right! All right, let's go!

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Come on.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: How are you doing, Doc?

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: I'll let you know.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Don't fire. First man that fires is dead.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: That thing has killed fifty of my men.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: You've killed thousands of her children.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: What?

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Those round silicon nodules that you've been collecting and destroying? They're her eggs. Tell them, Mister Spock.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: There have been many generations of Horta on this planet. Every fifty thousand years, the entire race dies, all but one, like this one, but the eggs live. She cares for them, protects them. And when they hatch, she is the mother to them, thousands of them. This creature here is the mother of her race.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: The Horta is intelligent, peaceful, mild. She had no objection to sharing this planet with you, till you broke into her nursery and started destroying her eggs. Then she fought back in the only way she knew how, as any mother would fight when her children are in danger.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: We didn't know. How could we? You mean if these eggs hatch, there'll be thousands of those things crawling around down here?

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: This is where they live. They digest rock, they tunnel for nourishment.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: And they are the most inoffensive of creatures. They harbor ill will towards no one.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Now look, we have pergium to deliver.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Yes, I know. Here's your circulating pump. You've complained this planet is a mineralogical treasure house if you had the equipment to get at it. Gentlemen, the Horta moves through rock the way we move through air, and it leaves tunnels. The greatest natural miners in the universe. It seems to me we could make an agreement, reach a modus vivendi. They tunnel. You collect and process, and your process operation would be a thousand times more profitable.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Sounds all right, if it will work.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Except for one thing. The Horta is badly wounded. It may die.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: It won't die. By golly, Jim, I'm beginning to think I can cure a rainy day.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Can you help it?

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Help it? I cured it.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: How?

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Well, I had the ship beam down a hundred pounds of that thermoconcrete. You know, the kind we use to build emergency shelters out of. It's mostly silicone. So I just trowelled it into the wound, and it'll act like a bandage until it heals. Take a look. It's as good as new.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Well, Spock, I'm going to have to ask you to get in touch with the Horta again. Tell her our proposition. She and her children can do all the tunneling they want. Our people will remove the minerals, and each side will leave the other alone. Think she'll go for it?

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: It seems logical, Captain. The Horta has a very logical mind. And after close association with humans, I find that curiously refreshing.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Ship ready to leave orbit, Captain. Course laid in.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Very good, Mister Spock.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Chief Engineer Vanderberg standing by on channel one.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Fine. Yes, Chief. Kirk here.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Just wanted to tell you the eggs have started to hatch, Captain.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: First thing the little devils do is start to tunnel.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: We've already hit huge new pergium deposits. I'm afraid to tell you how much gold and platinum and rare earths we've uncovered.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: I'm delighted to hear that, Chief. Once Mother Horta tells her kids what to look for, you people are going to be embarrassingly rich.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: You know, the Horta aren't so bad once you're used to their appearance.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Well. that's about it, Kirk. Thanks for everything.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Our pleasure, Chief. Kirk out.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Curious. What Chief Vanderberg said about the Horta is exactly what the Mother Horta said to me. She found humanoid appearance revolting, but she thought she could get used to it.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Oh, she did, did she? Now tell me, did she happen to make any comment about those ears?

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Not specifically, but I did get the distinct impression she found them the most attractive human characteristic of all. I didn't have the heart to tell her that only I have

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: She really liked those ears?

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Captain, the Horta is a remarkably intelligent and sensitive creature, with impeccable taste.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Because she approved of you?

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Really, Captain, my modesty

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Does not bear close examination, Mister Spock. I suspect you're becoming more and more human all the time.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Captain, I see no reason to stand here and be insulted.

title: The Devil In The Dark
line: Ahead, warp factor two.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Captain, we've reached the designated position for scanning the coded directive tape.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Good. We both guessed right. Negotiations with the Klingon Empire are on the verge of breaking down. Starfleet Command anticipates a surprise attack. We are to proceed to Organia and take whatever steps are necessary to prevent the Klingons from using it as a base.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Strategically sound. Organia is the only Class M planet in the disputed area, ideally located for use by either side.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Organia's description, Mister Spock.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Inhabited by humanoids. A very peaceful, friendly people living on a primitive level. Little of intrinsic value. Approximately Class D minus on Richter's scale of cultures.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Another Armenia, Belgium.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Sir?

title: Errand of Mercy
line: The weak innocents who always seem to be located on the natural invasion routes.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Captain, the automatic deflector screen just popped on. Body approaching.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Configuration, Mister Sulu.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Phaser banks, lock on. Return fire. Maintain firing rate. One hundred percent dispersal pattern.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: We've hit him, Captain. He's hurt.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Damage control, report to the first officer.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Captain, the other ship doesn't register. Only drifting debris. We got him.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: All hands, maintain general alert. Hold battle stations. Damage report, Mister Spock.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Minor, Captain. We were most fortunate. Blast damage in decks ten and eleven, minor buckling in the antimatter pods, casualties very light.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Maintain surveillance, Mister Sulu.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: No contact, Captain. He blew up all right.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Well, we've been anticipating an attack. I'd say what we've just experienced very nearly qualifies.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Yes. It would seem to be an unfriendly act.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Automatic all-points relay from Starfleet Command, Captain, code one.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Well, there it is. War. We didn't want it, but we've got it.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Curious how often you humans manage to obtain that which you do not want.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: War or not, we've still got a job to do. Denying Organia to the Klingons.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: With the outbreak of hostilities, that might not be easy.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Lay in a course for Organia, Mister Sulu.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Aye, aye, sir.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Negotiating with the Organians will be time-consuming, Captain, and time is one thing we'll have the least of.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: We won't get it by talking about it. The trigger's been pulled. We have to get there before the hammer falls. Ahead warp factor seven.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Captain's log, stardate 3198.4. We have reached Organia and established standard orbit. No signs of hostile activities in this area.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Captain. Unit XY-75847 report a fleet of Klingon ships in their sector, sir.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: What bearing?

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Unable to ascertain, sir.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Mister Sulu, have the phaser crews stand by their positions. Full power deflector screens.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Yes, sir.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Mister Spock and I are going to the planet's surface. You will be in command. Your responsibility is to the Enterprise, not to us. Is that clear?

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Perfectly, sir.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: The Klingon fleet is in this quadrant. We know that Organia will be a target. If they should emerge

title: Errand of Mercy
line: We'll handle them, sir.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: You will evaluate the situation. If there is a fleet of them, you'll get out of here, Mister Sulu.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: But, Captain

title: Errand of Mercy
line: No buts. You'll get to safety and alert the fleet. You will not attack alone. Mister Spock and I will be all right. Mister Spock, let's you and I pay the Organians a visit.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: You'd think they had people beaming down every day.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Yes. Curious lack of interest. Notice the ruins in the distance, Captain. Quite large.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Yes. A fortress, perhaps. A castle.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Whatever it is, it would seem to be inconsistent with the reports we've been given on this culture.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Welcome.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Reception committee?

title: Errand of Mercy
line: It would seem so.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: You are our visitors. Welcome, welcome. I am Ayelborne.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: I am Captain James T. Kirk of the starship Enterprise, representing the United Federation of Planets. This is my first officer Mister Spock.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: You are most welcome, my friend.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: I would like to speak to someone in authority.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: We don't have anybody in authority, but I am the chairman of the Council of Elders. Perhaps I would do.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: You people are in great danger. Is there someplace we can go and talk?

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Oh, yes. Our council chambers are nearby. Please.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Captain, if you don't mind, I should like to wander about the village and make some studies.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Of course, my friend. Our village is yours. Captain.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Gentlemen, my government has informed me that the Klingons are expected to move against your planet with the objective of making it a base of operation against the Federation. My mission, frankly, is to keep them from doing it.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: What you're saying, Captain, is that we seem to have a choice between dealing with you or your enemies.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: No, sir. With the Federation, you have a choice. You have none with the Klingons. The Klingons are a military dictatorship. War is their way of life. Life under the Klingon rule would be very unpleasant. We offer you protection.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: We thank you for your altruistic offer, Captain, but we really do not need your protection.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: We are a simple people, Captain. We have nothing that anybody could want.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: You have this planet and its strategic location. I assure you that if you don't take action to prevent it, the Klingons will move against you as surely as your sun rises. We will help you build defenses, build facilities.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: We have no defenses, Captain, nor are any needed.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Gentlemen, I have seen what the Klingons do to planets like yours. They are organized into vast slave labor camps. No freedoms whatsoever. Your goods will be confiscated. Hostages taken and killed, your leaders confined. You'd be far better off on a penal planet. Infinitely better off.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Captain, we see that your concern is genuine. We are moved. But again we assure you we are in absolutely no danger. If anybody is in danger, you are, and that concerns us greatly. It would be better if you returned to your ship as soon as possible.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: You keep insisting there's no danger. I keep assuring you there is. Would you mind telling me

title: Errand of Mercy
line: It is our way of life, Captain.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: That's the first thing that would be lost! Excuse me, gentlemen. I'm a soldier, not a diplomat. I can only tell you the truth.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: If you will excuse us, Captain, we will discuss your kind offer.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Certainly.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Captain, our information on these people and their culture was not correct. This is not a primitive society making progress toward mechanization. They are totally stagnant. There is no evidence of any progress as far back as my tricorder can register.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: That doesn't seem likely.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Nevertheless, it is true. For tens of thousands of years, there has been absolutely no advancement, no significant change in their physical environment. This is a laboratory specimen of an arrested culture.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Thank you, Mister Spock. That might be useful.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: We have discussed your offer, Captain. Our opinion is unchanged. We are in no danger. We thank you for your kind offer of assistance, although we must decline it, and we strongly recommend that you leave Organia before you yourselves are endangered.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Gentlemen, I must get you to reconsider. We can be of immense help to you. In addition to military aid, we can send you specialists, technicians. We can show you how to feed a thousand people where one was fed before. We can help you build schools, educate the young in the latest technological and scientific skills. Your public facilities are almost non-existent. We can help you remake your world, end disease, hunger, hardship. All we ask in return is that you let us help you. Now.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Captain, I can see that you do not understand us. Perhaps

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Excuse me, sir. Kirk here.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Captain, a large number of Klingon vessels have just arrived.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: They're opening fire.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Positive identification?

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Yes, sir. My screens are up. I can't drop them to beam you aboard.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Mister Sulu, follow your orders. Get out of here. Contact the fleet. Return if the odds are more equal. Kirk out. Gentlemen, you kept insisting that there was no danger

title: Errand of Mercy
line: That is correct, Captain. There is no danger.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Ayelborne, eight space vehicles have assumed orbit around our planet. They are activating their material transmission units.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Thank you, Trefayne.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Can you verify that?

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Negative, Captain, but it seems a logical development.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Captain, since it is too late for you to escape, perhaps we should do something about protecting you.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: If you had listened to me

title: Errand of Mercy
line: We must be sure you are not harmed.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Ayelborne, several hundred men have appeared near the citadel. They bring many weapons.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: How does he know that?

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Oh, our friend Trefayne is really quite intuitive. You can rest assured that what he says is absolutely correct.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: So we're stranded here, in the middle of a Klingon occupation army.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: So it would seem. Not a very pleasant prospect.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: You have a gift for understatement, Mister Spock. It's not a very pleasant prospect at all. Captain's Log. stardate 3201.7. Mister Spock and I are trapped on the planet Organia, which is in the process of being occupied by the forces of the Klingon Empire. The Organians have provided us with native clothing in the hopes we may be taken for Organians.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Captain, our phasers are gone.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Did you take them?

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Yes, Captain. I took them.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: I must ask you to return them.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: I'm sorry, Captain. I cannot do that. Were you armed, you might be tempted to use violence, and that we cannot permit. You, Captain, will pass as an Organian, and Mister Spock. Mister Spock presents a problem. He doesn't look like an Organian.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: A Vulcan trader, perhaps. A dealer in kevas and trillium. Harmless to the Klingons.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: They know that Vulcan is a member of the Federation.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Vulcan merchants are not uncommon, Captain. It is a practical approach.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: What about the rest of you?

title: Errand of Mercy
line: We shall continue as before. We have nothing to fear.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: You have a lot to learn, sir. And if I know the Klingons, you'll be learning it the hard way.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: This is the ruling council?

title: Errand of Mercy
line: I am Ayelborne, temporary head of the council. I bid you welcome.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: No doubt you do. I am Kor, military governor of Organia. Who are you?

title: Errand of Mercy
line: He is Baroner, one of our leading citizens.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: And he has no tongue?

title: Errand of Mercy
line: I have a tongue.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Good. You will be taught how to use it. Where is your smile?

title: Errand of Mercy
line: My what?

title: Errand of Mercy
line: The stupid, idiotic smile everyone else seems to be wearing. A Vulcan. Do you also have a tongue?

title: Errand of Mercy
line: I am Spock, a dealer in kevas and trillium.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: You do not look like a storekeeper. Take this man. Vulcans are members of the Federation. He may be a spy.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: He's no spy.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Well, have we a ram among the sheep? Do you object to us taking him?

title: Errand of Mercy
line: He's done nothing. Nothing at all.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Coming from an Organian, yours is practically an act of rebellion. Very good. So you welcome me. Do you also welcome me?

title: Errand of Mercy
line: You're here. There's nothing I can do about it.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Good honest hatred. Very refreshing. However, it makes no difference whether you welcome me or not. I am here and will stay. You are now subjects of the Klingon Empire. You'll find there are many rules and regulations. They will be posted. Violation of the smallest of them will be punished by death.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: We shall obey your regulations, Commander.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: You disapprove, Baroner.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: You need my approval?

title: Errand of Mercy
line: I need your obedience. Nothing more. Will I have it?

title: Errand of Mercy
line: You seem to be in command.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Yes. I am. I shall need a representative from among you. Liaison between the forces of the occupation and the civil population. Smile and smile. I don't trust men who smile too much. You, Baroner, you're the man.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Me? I don't want the job.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Have I asked whether or not you want it? We Klingons have a reputation for ruthlessness. You will find that it is deserved. Should one Klingon soldier be killed, a thousand Organians will die. I will have order. Is that clear?

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Commander, I assure you our people want nothing but peace. We shall cause you no trouble.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: I'm sure you will not. Take the Vulcan to the examination room. You, come with me. I will familiarize you with your new duties.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: And Mister Spock?

title: Errand of Mercy
line: You are concerned?

title: Errand of Mercy
line: He is my friend.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: You have a poor choice of friends. He will be examined. If he is lying, he will die. If he is telling the truth, he will find that business has taken a turn for the worse. Take him. You do not like to be pushed. Very good. You may be a man I can deal with, Baroner. Come with me.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: From this day on, no public assemblages of more than three people. All publications to be cleared through this office. Neighborhood controls will be established, hostages selected. A somewhat lengthy list of crimes against the state.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: You do not like them? Well?

title: Errand of Mercy
line: He is what he claims to be, Commander, a Vulcanian merchant named Spock. His main concern seems to be how he would carry out his business under our occupation.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Nothing else?

title: Errand of Mercy
line: The usual. A certain amount of apprehension regarding us. The mind is remarkably disciplined.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: You are sure?

title: Errand of Mercy
line: I used force four, which is sufficient to break down any pretense.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Very well, Lieutenant. Would you like to try our little truth finder?

title: Errand of Mercy
line: I don't understand.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: It's a mind-sifter or mind-ripper, depending on how much force is used. We can record every thought, every bit of knowledge in a man's mind. Of course, when that much force is used, the mind is emptied. Permanently, I'm afraid. What's left is more vegetable than human.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: And you're proud of it.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: It is a tool, a weapon. Somewhat drastic, but very efficient.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Are you sure you're all right?

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Perfectly, Baroner. But it was an interesting experience.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: All right, Vulcan, you may go. But you are an enemy alien. You will be under our scrutiny at all times. If I have to warn you

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Not necessary, Commander. I understand you very well.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Return to your council, Baroner. You will receive our official notifications as soon as they are published. In the meantime keep the people in order. It is your responsibility.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Or I will be killed.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: That is exactly right. You will be killed.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: That mindsifter can't be all the terror they think it is.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: It should not be underestimated, Captain. It reaches directly into the mind. We Vulcans have certain mental certain disciplines which enable me to maintain a shield. Without those disciplines, there would be no protection.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: I'll try and avoid it.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Out of the way, Organian.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: I'm sorry, sir. We did not notice you.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Next time, keep your eyes open, or I'll shut them permanently.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: Captain, I strongly suggest we direct our energies toward the immediate problem. Accomplishing our mission here.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: You didn't really think I was going to beat his head in, did you?

title: Errand of Mercy
line: I thought you might.

title: Errand of Mercy
line: You're right. But as you say, we still have a job to do.

title: Errand of Mercy

title: The Ultimate Computer
line: I don't mean that. I'm getting a Red Alert right here. That thing is dangerous. I feel. Only a fool would stand in the way of progress, if this is progress. You have my psychological profiles. Am I afraid of losing my job to that computer?

title: The Ultimate Computer
line: Under human control.

title: The Ultimate Computer
line: We're all sorry for the other guy when he loses his job to a machine. When it comes to your job, that's different. And it always will be different.

title: The Ultimate Computer
line: Am I afraid of losing command to a computer? Daystrom's right. I can do a lot of other things. Am I afraid of losing the prestige and the power that goes with being a starship captain? Is that why I'm fighting it? Am I that petty?
