title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Prepare phaser banks one and two, Mister Sulu.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Aye, sir.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Mister Chekov, get a fix on the missile's point of origin.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Aye, Captain.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Phasers one and two locked in and ready.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Fire phasers. Mister Chekov, alter course to the missile's point of origin.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Aye, sir.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Warp factor three, Mister Sulu.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Warp factor three, sir.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: I am a nurse first, Doctor McCoy, and a member of the crew of the Enterprise second.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: You're excused. You may return to your quarters.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: No, I'm sorry, Doctor. I've called the Captain and I'll wait until he comes.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: What's the emergency?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: I said you were excused, Nurse. Please, Christine. I promise you I'll give the Captain a full report.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: That was quite a scene.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: I've just completed the standard physical examinations for the entire crew.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Excellent. What's the emergency?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: The crew is fit. I found nothing unusual, with one exception.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Serious?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Terminal.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: What is it?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Xenopolycythemia. It has no cure.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Who?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: He has one year to live.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Who is it?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: The ship's Chief Medical Officer.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: You.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: I'll be most effective on the job in the time left, if you'll keep this to yourself.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Captain's log, stardate 5476.3. I have just had the sad duty of informing Starfleet about Doctor McCoy's condition and have requested an immediate replacement.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Mister Spock.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Yes, Captain?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Confirm Chekov's co-ordinates for the missile's point of origin.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Correct, Captain. We are approaching those co-ordinates.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: That object on the screen?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: An asteroid, two hundred miles in diameter.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Could the enemy vessel be hiding behind the asteroid?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Negative, Captain. We've had that area on scanners constantly.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Then the asteroid is the missile's point of origin.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Correct, Captain.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Full sensor probe, Mister Spock.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Typical asteroid chemically, but it is not orbiting. It is pursing an independent course through this solar system.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: How could that be? Unless it's powered. A spaceship?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: It is under power, Captain. And correcting for all gravitational stresses.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Source of power?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Atomic. Very archaic. Leaving a trail of debris and hard radiation.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Mister Chekov, plot the course of the asteroid vessel.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Aye, sir.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Asteroid has an outer shell, which is hollow. It surrounds an independent inner core, which has a breathable atmosphere. Sensors read no life forms.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Then it must be on automatic controls.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Then the passengers, or builders, are dead.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Course of asteroid, I mean spaceship two four one mark one seven.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Interesting.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Yes?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: The course Ensign Chekov just gave for the asteroid would put it on a collision course with Daran Five.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Daran Five? Inhabited?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Correct. Population approximately three billion and seven hundred twenty four million, if memory serves me correctly. Estimated time of impact three hundred ninety six days.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Mister Sulu, match Enterprise speed with that of the asteroid vessel. Mister Spock and I are transporting aboard. Mister Scott, you have the conn.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Aye, sir.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: A lot can happen in a year. Please, give yourself every minute.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Doctor McCoy, Mister Spock and I will handle this.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Without me, Jim? You'd never find your way back.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Well, I think it would be wiser if

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: I'd like to go. I'm fine, Captain.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: All right, Doctor. If that's what you want.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: You'd swear you were on the surface of a planet.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: One fails to see the logic in making a ship look like a planet.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Wouldn't know this was a spaceship. Kirk to Enterprise.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Enterprise. Scott here.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Transported without incident. Kirk out.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: No apparent opening.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: You found no intelligent life forms, Mister Spock, but surely

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: The asteroid ship is over ten thousand years old, Doctor. Still no sign of life forms, Captain.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: These are weapons?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Of a sort. Weapons, communication devices. Let me go to my friend.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: You all right?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: I think so.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: I am Natira, the high priestess of the people. Welcome to the world of Yonada.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: I can't say I think much of your welcome.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Take them.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: You will kneel.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: She called this the world. These people don't know they're on a spaceship.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: They've been in flight ten thousand years. Maybe they don't realize it.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Oh, Oracle of the people, most perfect and wise. Strangers have come to our world. They bear instruments we do not understand.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Who are you?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: I am Captain Kirk of the starship Enterprise. This is my medical officer, Doctor McCoy. My first officer, Mister Spock.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: For what reason do you visit this world?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: We've come in friendship.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Then learn what it means to be our enemy before you learn what it means to be our friend.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Spock. Doctor McCoy. Bones. Bones?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: The doctor must have received an excessively large electrical shock.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: No, that's not it.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Nothing else could've caused this, Captain. At least nothing that has happened here.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: You're right, Spock. The shock was serious because of McCoy's weakened condition.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: May I ask precisely what is troubling the doctor?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: I don't think he would've told you himself, but I think you should know now. It's xenopolycythemia.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Yes. I know of it, Captain.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Then you know that nothing can be done.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Bones, how is it?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: I'm all right. Are you all right, Mister Spock?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Very well, Doctor. The Captain and I seem to have suffered no ill effects.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Oh, that Oracle really got to me. I must be especially susceptible to its magic spells.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Spock knows.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Well, we'd better get to the control room.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Are you in any condition to get up?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Don't worry. I can make it, Jim.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Captain, informing these people they're on a ship may be in violation of the Prime Directive of Starfleet Command.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: No. The people of Yonada may be changed by the knowledge, but it's better than exterminating them.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Logical, Captain.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: And the three billion on Daran Five.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Also logical, Captain.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Gentlemen, I believe we have a visitor.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: For strength. Many of us have felt the power of our Oracle. This has been of benefit.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: It tastes like an ancient herb derivative.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: You are not of Yonada.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: No, we're from outside your world.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Where is outside?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Up there. Outside, up there, everywhere.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: So they say, also. Many years ago I climbed the mountains, even though it is forbidden.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Why is it forbidden?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: I am not sure. But things are not as they teach us. For the world is hollow, and I have touched the sky.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: What is it, Bones?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: There's something under the skin. He's dead.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: For the world is hollow, and I have touched the sky.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: He said it was forbidden to climb the mountains.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Yes, of course it is, because if you did you'd touch the sky and find out that you were living on a big ball. Not a planet, but a spaceship. And that knowledge seems to be forbidden.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: What happened?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: We don't know. He just suddenly screamed in pain and died.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Fetch the guard. Forgive him for he was an old man, and old men are sometimes foolish. But it is written that those of the people who sin or speak evil shall be punished. He served well for many years. Take him away, gently.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: You do not seem well. It is distressing to me.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Oh, no. I'm quite all right, thank you.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: It is the will of the Oracle that you now be treated as honored guests.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: You seem to be the special favorite.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Indeed, Doctor. The young lady did show a marked preference for your company.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Well, now. Nobody can blame her for that, can they?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Personally, I find the lady's taste questionable, but she obviously prefers you, and you obviously don't seem to mind. If you could arrange to be alone with the young lady, Spock and I would be left alone to find the power controls of this world.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: It is time to refresh yourselves.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Thank you, Mister Spock. To our good friends of Yonada.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: We are very interested in your world.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: That pleases us.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Good. Then you wouldn't mind if we looked around?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Not at all. The people know of you now. Are you well enough to go about?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Perhaps not.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Then why not remain here? Rest. We will talk.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: You are very kind.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: You are free to go about and meet our people.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Thank you. And thank you for taking care of Doctor McCoy.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Not at all. We shall make him well.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Mister Spock.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: No, thank you.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Leave us.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: I'm curious. How did the Oracle punish the old man?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: I cannot tell you now.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: There is some way the Oracle knows what you say, isn't there?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: What we say, what we think. The Oracle knows the minds and the hearts of all the people. I did not know you would be hurt so badly.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: It's all right. I suppose we had to learn the power of the Oracle.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: McCoy, there is something I must say. Since the moment I. It is not in the manner of the people to hide their feelings.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Honesty is usually wise.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Is there a woman for you?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: No, there isn't.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Does McCoy find me attractive?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Oh, yes. Yes, I do.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: I hope you men of space, of other worlds, hold truth as dear as we do.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: We do.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: I wish you to stay here on Yonada as my mate.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: But we're strangers to each other.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: But is not that the nature of men and women? That the pleasure is in the learning of each other?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Yes.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Let the thought rest in your heart, McCoy.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Incredible as it may seem, these people have no idea they're living on a spaceship.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: I wonder how many generations have lived out their lives and been buried here without ever knowing that their world is hollow.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: The people, in the fullness of time, will reach a new world. Rich, green, lovely to the eyes, and of a goodness that will fill the hearts of the people with tears of joy. You can share that world with me, rule it by my side.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: How long will it take you to reach this new world?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Soon. The Oracle will only say soon.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: If you only knew how I needed some kind of future, Natira.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: You have lived a lonely life?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Yes, very lonely.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: No more, McCoy. There will be no more loneliness for you.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: There's something I need to tell you.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: There is nothing you need to say.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: But there is.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Then tell me, if the telling is such a need.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: I have an illness for which there is no cure. I have one year to live.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Until I saw you, there was nothing in my heart. It sustained my life, but nothing more. Now it sings. I could be happy to have that feeling for a day, a week, a month, a year. Whatever the creators hold in store for us.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Captain, the Oracle room.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: The problem, to get in.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: I believe that I can. The writing is definitely Fabrini, Captain. I recognize it.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Fabrini? Didn't the Fabrini sun go nova and destroy its planets?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Yes. Towards the end, the Fabrini people lived underground, as these people do, to protect themselves.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Some of them must have been put aboard this ship and sent to another planet. And these are their descendants. Now.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: The Oracle doesn't seem to know we're here. I wonder what alerted it the first time.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Captain. If I remember correctly, the oracle's reprehensible conduct was initiated when Natira knelt on that platform.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: I think you're right. Continue investigating. The clue to the location of the control room must be around here somewhere.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Nothing here which would indicate this is anything but a planet. There's no question but that the creators would be considered gods.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: This plaque is a representation of a star and its solar system.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Eight planets, Captain. That is the number in the Fabrina solar system.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Then there's no doubt these people are the descendants of the Fabrini.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: And no doubt they've been in flight on this asteroid ship for ten thousand years.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Speak.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: It is I, Natira.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Yes, Natira.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: It is written only the high priestess of the people may select her mate.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: It is so written.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: The strangers among us, the three visitors. There is one called McCoy. I wish him to remain here as my mate.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Does he agree to this?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: I have asked him. He has not yet given me his answer.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: He must become one of the people, worship the creators, and agree to the insertion of the Instrument of Obedience.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: He will be told what must be done.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: If he agrees to all things, it is permitted. Teach him our laws carefully so he commits no sacrilege, no offense against the people or the creators.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: It will be done, o most wise.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Who are the intruders?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Two of the strangers, Kirk and Spock.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: McCoy is not with them?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: No.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Kirk and Spock have committed sacrilege. You know what must be done.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: I know. When the oracle releases them, take them. Fools. You think we are children? You think you can do as you please, commit whatever offense amuses you?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: What are you going to do to my friends?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: They entered the Oracle room.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: And the punishment is death?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Yes. I can make no other decision. We gave them our trust, they betrayed us.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: They acted out of ignorance, Natira.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: They said they came in friendship.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Please let them return to the ship.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: I cannot.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: For me? I've made my decision. I'm staying here, on Yonada. Natira, what they did, they did because they felt they had to. Please, let them return to the ship. You won't regret it. How do you think I'd feel if I stayed here with the chance to be happy for the first time in my life, but knowing my friends had died?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Yes. So be it. This I will do for McCoy. For our happiness and future.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: You're returning with us?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: No, I'm not.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Bones, this isn't a planet. It's a space ship on a collision course with Daran Five.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: I'm on a kind of a collision course myself, Jim.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Doctor McCoy, I order you to return with us.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: And I refuse.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Bones, if we can't correct the course of this ship, we'll have to blast it out of space.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: I intend to stay on this ship, with these people, whatever happens.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Your decision is most illogical, Doctor.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Is it, Mister Spock? Is it really? Natira's asked me to stay, and I'm staying.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: As her husband?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Yes. Is that too much to ask, Jim?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Kirk to Enterprise.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Scott here, Captain.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: We're beaming over. Lock in on our signal.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: Aye, Captain.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: And transport Mister Spock and myself immediately.

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: But, Captain, what about Doctor McCoy?

title: For The World Is Hollow And I Have Touched The Sky
line: He's staying, Scotty. Kirk out.

line: You say everyone is gone? Where'd they go?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: It depended on the individual, of course. If you wish to trace a specific person, I'm sorry, but that information is confidential.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: No, no particular person, just people in general. Where did they go?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Ah, you find it difficult to choose, is that it? Yes, a wide range of alternatives is a mixed blessing, but perhaps I can help. Would you step this way, please?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: May I help you? You may select from more than twenty thousand verism tapes, several hundred of which have only recently been added to the collection. I'm sure you'll find something here that pleases you. You, sir, what is your particular field of interest?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: What about recent history?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Really? Oh, that's too bad. We have so little on recent history. There was no demand for it.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: It doesn't have to be extensive, Just the answers to a few questions.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Of course. Reference services available at the desk.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: You're very late. Where have you been?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: You're a very agile man, Mister Atoz. Just how many of you are there? We came as soon as we knew what was happening.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Forgive me, sir. It is my fault. I must have miscalculated. Our readings indicated that there was no one here at all.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Of course I know. Everyone on this planet was warned of the coming nova long ago. They followed instructions and are now safe. And you had better do the same.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Did you say they were safe?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Absolutely. Every single one.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Where did they go?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Wherever they wanted to go, of course. It is strictly up to the individual's choice.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: I see. And you personally sent all these people on the planet to safety?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Yes, yes, yes. They are all gone, except you three. Of course, I had to delegate the simple tasks to my replicas.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: You are the real one, Mister Atoz?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Of course. I am the real Mister Atoz.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: As a matter of fact, he's quite real, Jim.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Let us take you with us to a place of safety.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: No, thank you. I plan to join my wife and family when the time comes. Now, don't be concerned about me. Think of yourselves. I warn you most urgently. Make your escape before it's too late. The library is at your complete service. I will gladly supply you with all reference material to help you. History of the planet is available in every detail. Just choose what interests you the most. The millennium, the century, the date, the moment. The library is your key. Oh! It's in the wrong file. Make your own selection, but remember, you're very late.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: We'll choose it as quick as we can. How long till nova?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Three hours, thirteen minutes.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: This gentleman is not

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: You, sir. I think you'll find something interesting over here.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Now, if these won't do, I can bring you another file.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Have you made your selection, sir?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Exactly what is it that I'm expected to select?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: I'm sure I was clear. The period in which you're interested.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: I see. This is a fascinating machine. What is it?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Ah, this is the atavachron.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Interesting nomenclature. How does it work? May I

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Oh, no, sir, no. I must ask you not to touch the controlling mechanism. Return and make your selection. When you have chosen, I will prepare you through the atavachron.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Thank you, Mister Atoz.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Spock. Bones.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Wait! I haven't prepared you.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: You must be prepared!

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: What is this place?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Yes, and where is the captain?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: You dirty thing. Let go of me!

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Vile vixen!

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Come when you are bidden, slave! You need a lesson in how to use your betters. Who's your master?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: I'm a free man, sir.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Then you want better manners, free man. Defend yourself!

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Heating this boulder may provide some temporary heat.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: What's wrong?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Something's preventing my phaser from operating.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Oh, thank you, man. I thought I'd be limbered sure when that gull caught me cutting his purse.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: What's that? Are you all right?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Oh, I took you to be an angler, but you're none of us, are ya? Well, you're a bully fine coe for all of that. What a handsome dish ya served them, the coxcombs.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: You better come back with me to the library. You'll be safe there. Doctor McCoy can see to those bruises.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: I'm game, love. Lead and I'll follow. Where's library?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: It's right over there.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Where's the captain, Spock? We were right behind him.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: What's with you, man? Let's make off before coxcombs come with shoulder clappers.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: No. Do you remember when you first saw me? Do you remember whether I came through some kind of door?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Oh, I think the rum gull must've kicked you in the head. Come on, love. I know a leech who'll ask no questions.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: No. No. It must be here someplace.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Jim!

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Jim, can you hear us?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Bones? Spock?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Captain, we hear you, but we cannot see you.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Are you all right?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: We must've missed each other somehow.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Agreed.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Apparently they've all escaped the destruction of their world by retreating into its past.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Mercy on us. It's spirits.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: No, no. No, no, no. These are friends of mine, and they're

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Spock, are you in the library?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Indeed not. We're in a wilderness of arctic characteristics.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: He means it's cold.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Can you get to the library?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: There is no library, Captain, at least not that we can see. We are at the base of an ice cliff.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Explain.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Just before you disappeared, Captain, I discovered a machine which Mister Atoz called the atavachron.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: It must have been tied in to the tape viewer somehow.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Opening time portals to the past. You cross through into the period which you were viewing.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: I was looking over some material about their Ice Age.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: I am here, evidently, because I stepped through at the same instant as Doctor McCoy.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Yes. My friends are coming back with reinforcements.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: There's the mort's accomplice. Arrest him.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: We are the law, and do require that you yield to us.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: On what charge?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Thievery and purse cutting.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: That's a mistake. I'm no thief.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: What's happening?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Lord help us. What's that?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: It's spirits.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Away. Away, spirit, and let honest men approach.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Keep talking!

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Captain!

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: They speak at his bidding. Stop his mouth and they'll quiet.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: You must be close to the portal.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Jim, what's the matter? Jim sounded like he was in trouble.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: We may be in trouble ourselves. We must find shelter.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: In this severe cold, we cannot survive much longer.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Leave me here, Spock.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: We go together or not at all.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Don't be a fool. My hands and face are frostbitten. I can't feel my feet. Alone you have a chance. Now do what I say. Go try to find Jim.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: We go together.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: You stubborn, thickheaded Vulcan!

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: He's suffering from the severity of your weather. Unfortunately, he is the doctor, not I. I'll avoid giving him any medication at this time. Perhaps, if he's kept quiet and warm, he may recover naturally. It is agreeably warm here.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: What are you called?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: I'm called Spock.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Even your name is strange. Forgive me. I've never seen anyone who looks like you. Why are you here? Are you prisoners too?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Prisoners?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: This is one of the places Zor Kahn sends people when he wants them to disappear. Didn't you come in through the time portal?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Yes, we came through the time portal, but not as prisoners. We were sent here by mistake.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: The atavachron is far away, but I think you come from someplace farther than that.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: That is true. I am not from the world you know at all. My home is a planet millions of light years away.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Oh, how wonderful! I've always loved books about such possibilities. But they are only stories. This isn't real. I must be imagining all this. I'm going mad!

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Listen to me. I am firmly convinced that I do exist. I am substantial. You are not imagining this.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Oh, I've been here for so long, alone. When I saw you out there, I couldn't believe it. Is he dying?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Here. There's the mort. And there's the mort's henchman.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Open up. Rouse him.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: You're the thief who talks to spirits.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: I'm a stranger.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Where are you from?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: An island.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: What is this island?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: It's called Earth.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: I know no island Earth. No matter. Continue.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: I never saw that woman before tonight. When she screamed, as far as I could tell, she was being attacked.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Then you deny being her accomplice?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Yes, I deny it. I was reading in the library when I heard her scream. My lord, the library? Do you remember where the library is, my lord?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Perhaps your part in this is innocent. I believe you to be an honest man.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: He's a witch!

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Take care, woman. I am convinced of your guilt. Do not compound it with false accusation.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: He speaks to unseen spirits. He's a witch! You heard the voices!

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: It's truth, my lord. I heard the spirit talk to him. He answered and did call it Bones.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: You're a witch. He cast a spell. He made me steal against my wish.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Surely you don't believe

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: You heard these spirits?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Aye, my lord. I'll witness to it.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: What he heard, my lord, were only my friends behind the wall in the library. In the library.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: I know nothing of this. Send for someone learned in witchcraft and let him examine him. I will have nothing to do with it.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: My lord, at least arrange for me to meet Mister Atoz.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: I know of no Atoz.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Yes! Yes! Atoz!

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: I know nothing of this, nothing of these matters! I will not hear him!

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Let me speak to you!

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: I will not hear him.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: At least let me talk to you!

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Witch! Witch! Witch! They'll burn ya.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: McCoy. McCoy, wake up.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Who are you?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: My name is Zarabeth.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Zarabeth. Spock, are we in the library?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: No, we are still in the Ice Age, but safe for the moment.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Jim. What about Jim?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Doctor, you're in no condition to get up. You lie down and rest. I shall attempt to find the captain.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: You find him, Spock. Don't you worry about me. You just find him.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Spock, who is this Jim?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: He's our commanding officer and our friend.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: I saw only the two of you. I did not know there was another.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: He did not come with us. He was sent through the time portal to another period in history much later than this one. If I am to find him, there is only one possible avenue. Zarabeth, will you show me where the time portal is?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: But your friend. He is ill.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Yes, that is true. If I leave him, there's a chance he may never regain the ship. He would then be marooned in this time period. But he is no longer in danger of death, so my primary duty to him has been discharged. If I remain here, no one of our party would be able to aid Captain Kirk.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: You make it sound like an equation.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: It should be an equation. I should be able to resolve this problem logically. Perhaps it has something to do with the atavachron. If only I knew more about how it worked. Zarabeth, you said that you were brought here as a prisoner. May I ask

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Why? My crime was in choosing my kinsmen unwisely. Two of them were involved in a conspiracy to kill Zor Kahn.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: I remember that name from the history tapes in the library. Zor Kahn the Tyrant.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: It was not enough that he execute my kinsmen. Zor Kahn determined to destroy our entire family. He used the atavachron to send us places no one could ever find us.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Zarabeth, I must return to Mister Atoz and the atavachron. We will carry Doctor McCoy, and you must come with us. I will send you and the doctor to the ship, and I shall search for Captain Kirk.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: I can't go through the portal again. If I do, I will die.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: You cannot go back?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: None of us can go back. When we come through the portal, we are changed by the atavachron. That is its function. Our basic cell structure is adjusted to the time we enter. You can't go back. If you go through the portal again, you will die by the time you reach the other side.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Spock? Where are we?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: You are safe here, McCoy.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Yes, I remember you.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Come, Doctor, back to bed.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Why are you still here, Spock? Why aren't you looking for Jim?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: It is impossible to look for him, Doctor. We cannot go back.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: What do you mean impossible? We've got to get back.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Zarabeth explained it to me. When we came through the time portal, it altered our physiological structure. If we attempt to return to the library, we shall die.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Are you trying to tell me that we're trapped here?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Yes, Doctor, we are trapped. Just as Jim is trapped wherever he is.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Captain's log, stardate 5943.9. The people of this time believe in witches, and witchcraft is what I've been accused of. Five witnesses heard McCoy's voice speak to me and thought it was an evil spirit. From what I know of witchcraft trials, I don't have much chance unless I can get to the prosecutor.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: No supper for you, love. Come on. Up you go.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Give me your cup.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Cry out and I'll break it. Don't move.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Jailor! Jailor!

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: I'm being falsely accused. You know that.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: You will come with me before the inquisitional tribunal. There the matter of your witchcraft will be decided.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: There are no such things as witches!

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Jailor! That is sacrilege. If they hear you, they will burn you for such beliefs.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: You're the only one that can hear me, and that's the truth. There are no witches. Why do you deny it?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Do not let them hear you. There are witches! There are! You yourself may be discovered to be a witch by the inquisitor. No! What are you doing? No!

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Help! Help!

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: I'll denounce you to the inquisitor. You came here from the future just as I did. Therefore, you, too, are a witch.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: I beg you. Do not implicate me. They would burn me.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Then help me.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: I will do everything I can to prove you innocent. I will disprove all the charges of witchcraft. But you must never again speak to the comrades you left behind.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Help me return to the library. I've lost my way. I must get back there.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: You cannot get back.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: I tell you I must! I had two friends with me, who are lost in another time period. I must find them. You'll come back with us.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: We can never go back. We must live out our lives here in the past. The atavachron has prepared our cell structure and our brain patterns to make life natural here. To return to the future would mean instant death.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Prepared? I was not prepared. Your Mister Atoz did not prepare me in any way.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Then you must get back at once! If you were not transformed, you can only survive for a few hours here in the past. Come. Hurry. Hurry.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Zarabeth, you are a beautiful cook. Have you ever been told that?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Not recently.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Oh, well, you'll find that Spock is quite delinquent in those matters.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: I hadn't noticed it.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Oh? Well, now that I'm feeling better, you'll notice a distinct difference in our approach.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Really?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: It's something to look forward to. I think you must be well enough, Doctor, to try the few delicacies this climate has to offer.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: No, not yet.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: At your rate of progress, it will be soon, I can see.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Doctor McCoy is making excellent progress.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: And Mister Spock has been practicing medicine without a license. Don't let him doctor you. I'm the doctor around here.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: And known as the worst patient in the entire crew of the Enterprise.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: I wonder where she is.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Five thousand years in the future.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Thank you.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: I wonder where Jim is.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Who knows. We can only hope that he is well, wherever he is.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: What do you mean, we can only hope? Haven't you done anything about it?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: What was there to do?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Locate the portal. It can't be too far.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: We've been through all that, Doctor. What's the point of rehashing that subject? We can't get back. Wasn't that clear to you?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Yes, that was clear to me.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Then perhaps you were too ill to understand what can't get back means.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: I don't believe it, Spock. It's just not like you to give up trying.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Then I'll repeat it for you. Get this through your head. We can't get back. That means we are trapped here in this planet's past just as we are, and we'll stay here for the rest of our lives. Now do you understand?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Yes, I understand. I never thought I'd hear it, but I understand. You want to stay here. As a matter of fact, you're highly motivated to stay in this forsaken waste.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: The prospect appeared quite attractive to you a moment ago.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: You listen to me, you pointed-eared Vulcan.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: I don't like that. I don't think I ever did, and now I'm sure.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: What's happening to you, Spock?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Nothing that shouldn't have happened long ago.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Long ago. Of course. Long ago.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: This is where it is. I can't remember the exact spot.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: That's it! That is the portal. I cannot wait any longer.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Spock? McCoy? Kirk to Enterprise. Come in.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Scott here, Captain.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: How much time before the sun blows up?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Seventeen minutes. You three had better come back right away.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: We can't, Scotty. Spock and McCoy are missing.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: I knew there was trouble. I've got a landing party standing by.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: No. Under no circumstances send anyone else here without my orders. Prepare to warp out and stand by. Kirk out. Mister Atoz, where are you?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: May I help you? It's you. You're lucky you found your way back here. Now let me process you through the atava

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: No. Mister Atoz, my friends and I are from another planet. We don't belong in your history. We don't belong on your planet at all.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Just let me take care of you and get you back where you belong.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: No. I want to find the exact disk that they were viewing.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Please, go back!

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: I'm sorry, Mister Atoz. Mister Atoz!

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: I must prepare to escape.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: I'll let you out in a minute. Still up to your little game of replicas? Which are you this time, real or not?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: You are evidently a suicidal maniac. I don't understand what you're trying to do, but if you continue, both of us will die. and I for one, do not wish death.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: If you help me, we won't die. I promise you that.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: I don't trust you.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Which one are you now, the replica or the real one?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: I am the real Atoz. You've done away with my replicas. I regret what I must now do.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: You don't really want to hurt me, do you? You've been trying to save my life. I realize that. Put that thing away.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: I cannot pretend to be sorry that you are here, though I realize it is a misfortune for you. I'm here against my will too, just as you are.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: I'm sorry. I know of no way to return you to your own time.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: It's not that I wish to return. This is my time now. I've had to face that. But it has been lonely here. Do you know what it's like to be alone? Really alone?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Yes. I know what it is like.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: I believe you do. Have something to eat, please.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: If it pleases you. This is animal flesh?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: There's not much else to eat around here, I'm afraid.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Naturally, because of the climate. What is the source of heat in the shelter?

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: There's an underground hot spring.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: Excellent. Then it will be possible to build a greenhouse of sorts. Meanwhile, this will have to do as the only source of nourishment.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: There aren't many luxuries around here. Zor Kahn only left me what was necessary to survive.

title: All Our Yesterdays
line: But he evidently intended that you continue living.

title: All Our Yesterdays
